payload.summary: Five unit tests fail on a clean, unmodified main (local Windows run)
payload.detail: Full 'npm run test' on main at cdfcbaccd with an empty working tree: 4 test files failed, 5 tests failed, 680 files / 7423 tests passed, duration 601.68s, exit code 1. Failures: (1) tests/codex-cloud-setup.test.ts > 'writes managed shell policy behaviorally and preserves unrelated Codex config'; (2) tests/hosted-migration-role-guard.test.ts > 'accepts the current repository state'; (3) tests/http-readiness.test.ts > 'honours the overall deadline when every response remains open'; (4) and (5) tests/document-viewer-page-virtualization.dom.test.tsx > 'reads exactly one page ahead and one behind, and only once idle' and > 'collapses render-ahead to the readers page alone when one canvas costs the whole budget' (both fail at flushIdle waitFor idleCallbacks.length > 0). Items 3-5 are deadline/idle-callback timing shapes and are the likeliest environmental Windows failures; items 1-2 assert repository state and look substantive rather than timing-dependent, so they should be reproduced in CI before being dismissed. Next: confirm against a CI run of the same SHA to split genuine breakage from local-environment flake, then either fix or add to the flake ledger per docs/testing.md (zero-retry policy, three reproductions on the same SHA before quarantine). Note the known local-Windows failures previously recorded were session-start-hook and worker-observability, which both PASSED in this run, so the failing set has changed.
